==Description==
'''v1.31.0''' is the eighty-fourth update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 11th of September 2024. It introduced four new skins and added multiple tower and consumable balance changes.

This update encompassed two versions, the main v1.31.0 update (released 11 September 2024) and the minor v1.31.1 update (released 11 September 2024).

==Additions==
===Skins===
*One new skin obtained from [[Mission Quests]].
**[[Militant]]: {{Color|Mission|Star Spartan}}
*One new skin obtained from the [[Daily Store#Daily Skin Store|Daily Skin Store]].
**[[Cowboy]]: {{Color|ContentCreator|Megalodon}}
*One new skin for the [[Deluxe Crate]].
**[[Brawler]]: {{Color|Deluxe|Loader}}
*One new skin for the [[Premium Crate]].
**[[Soldier]]: {{Color|Premium|Stealth Ops}}

===Miscellanous===
*'''For the Commander!''' [[Mission Quests|Mission]]

*Fixed [[Pistol Goon]] and [[Golden Pistol Goon]] not having flying detection.

===Consumables===
*[[Grenade]] buffed.
**Damage increased from 100 to 125.
**Updated description.
*[[Flash Bang]] buffed.
**Stun time increased from 4 to 5.
**Explosion range increased from 5 to 6.5
*[[Barricade]] initial cooldown increased from 20 to 45.
*[[Molotov]] rarity changed from {{Color|Uncommon}} to {{Color|Common}}.
*[[Supply Drop]] nerfed.
**Cash decreased from {{Money|1,200}} to {{Money|1,000}}.
**Initial cooldown increased from 60 to 75.
**Cooldown decreased from 75 to 60.
**Use limit decreased from 4 to 3.
**Updated description.
*[[Damage Flag]] nerfed.
**[[Damage Buff]] decreased from 40% to 20%.
**Range decreased from 20 to 16.
**Buff time decreased from 60 to 45.
**Updated description.
*[[Cooldown Flag]] nerfed.
**Range decreased from 20 to 16.
**Buff time decreased from 60 to 45.
**Updated description.
*[[Range Flag]] range decreased from 20 to 16.

===Enemies===
*[[Slow]] health increased from 18 to 20 in [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode.
*[[Ghoul]] health decreased from 180 to 175 in [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode.
*[[Hidden]] health increased from 15 to 20 in [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode.
*[[Armored]] health increased from 70 to 80 in [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode.
*[[Breaker2]] health increased from 30 to 40 in [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode.
*[[Breaker]] health increased from 12 to 20 in [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode.
*[[Skeleton]] health decreased from 55 to 30 in [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode.
*[[Reaver]] rebalanced.
**Health increased from 70 to 300.
**Defense of 100% added.
**Cash given increased from {{Money|150}} to {{Money|175}} every 50% health.
**[[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] attribute removed.
*[[Failed Experiment]] buffed.
**Health increased from 2,000 to 2,500.
**Speed increased (3.5 to 4).
**Now is a boss enemy when it first spawns.
*[[Patient Zero]] cash given increased from {{Money|7,000}} to {{Money|8,000}} every 10% health lost.
*[[Dummy Boss]] speed increased from Very Slow (1) to Slightly Slow (2).

===Miscellaneous===
*[[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode changed.
**Wave structure changed.
**Wave bonus equation changed.
*[[Health Regen]] regeneration rate increased from 1 to 2 seconds.
*Updated loading screen.

:In '''v1.31.1''':
